How It Works

How Professional Daycare Cleaning Works

Our daycare cleaning process follows a systematic, six-step protocol designed to maximize pathogen elimination and provide verifiable documentation of results. Every step is performed by trained, background-checked technicians.

1
Infant Room Sanitization

Cribs, changing tables, rocking chairs, and floor surfaces are sanitized using EPA Safer Choice products with zero fragrance and zero irritant potential. Floor-level sanitization receives extra attention because infants spend significant time on the floor and put objects in their mouths.

2
Toy and Play Surface Treatment

All toys, manipulatives, play tables, and shared materials are sanitized using child-safe disinfectants with appropriate dwell times. We follow state health department guidelines for toy rotation frequency — typically daily for mouthed toys and weekly for non-mouthed materials.

3
Changing Station Protocol

Diaper changing stations are sanitized after every use by daycare staff during the day. Our professional cleaning provides end-of-day deep sanitization of the changing surface, surrounding areas, waste receptacles, and supply storage to eliminate bacterial accumulation.

4
Kitchen and Food Prep Areas

Food preparation surfaces, high chairs, feeding tables, bottle preparation areas, and food storage zones are sanitized using products that meet both food-contact surface requirements and child-safe certification standards.

5
Restroom and Potty Training Areas

Child-height toilets, training potties, sinks, and surrounding floor areas receive intensive sanitization with particular attention to splash zones and high-touch surfaces. These areas require the highest disinfection frequency in the facility.

6
Documentation for Inspections

Every cleaning session is documented through JaniTrack with timestamped photos, product documentation, and task completion records. This creates the exact documentation trail that health department inspectors require and that facility directors can share with parents on request.

Industries in Philadelphia

Industries That Require Daycare Cleaning in Philadelphia

We deliver specialized daycare cleaning services across every commercial and institutional facility type in Philadelphia and throughout Philadelphia County. Each industry receives protocols tailored to its specific compliance requirements, risk profile, and operational constraints.

Infant Care Centers (0-12 months)

The most sanitization-intensive environment in childcare — crib sanitization, floor-level cleaning for non-mobile infants, bottle preparation area maintenance, and exclusively fragrance-free products for developing respiratory systems.

Toddler Programs (1-3 years)

High-frequency toy sanitization for the age group most actively mouthing objects, changing station deep cleaning, active play area maintenance, and nap room crib/mat sanitization between children.

Preschool Programs (3-5 years)

Classroom sanitization including art stations, learning centers, shared materials, bathroom training areas, and cafeteria surfaces with products that are both effective and safe for supervised independent use areas.

After-School Programs

Evening cleaning for programs operating in school facilities or dedicated spaces, with turnaround cleaning between school dismissal and program start and end-of-program deep cleaning.

Church-Based Childcare

Nursery and childcare rooms within houses of worship that must meet health department standards when providing regular childcare services, with flexible scheduling around worship service times.

Home-Based Childcare Networks

Periodic professional deep cleaning for licensed home-based childcare providers who need commercial-grade sanitization support for health department licensing compliance.

FAQ

Daycare Cleaning FAQ — Philadelphia, PA

Common questions about daycare cleaning services in Philadelphia.

What is professional daycare cleaning?+
Professional daycare cleaning is specialized sanitization service for childcare facilities that uses exclusively non-toxic, EPA Safer Choice or Green Seal certified products to sanitize infant rooms, toddler areas, play surfaces, changing stations, kitchens, and restrooms to health department licensing standards. It differs from standard commercial cleaning in its product requirements (zero toxicity), frequency demands (multiple daily sanitizations), and documentation standards (inspector-ready records).
What products do you use in daycare facilities?+
We exclusively use EPA Safer Choice and Green Seal certified products that are non-toxic, fragrance-free, dye-free, and specifically approved for environments where infants and toddlers are present. These products eliminate pathogens effectively while containing zero VOCs, zero fragrances, and zero chemical irritants. We never substitute conventional products regardless of availability — child safety is non-negotiable.
How do you sanitize toys and play equipment?+
Toys and play surfaces are sanitized using child-safe disinfectants applied with appropriate dwell times (the time the product must remain wet on the surface to be effective). We follow state health department guidelines for toy sanitization frequency: daily for mouthed toys and manipulatives, weekly for larger equipment and non-mouthed materials. Outdoor play equipment receives periodic sanitization on a scheduled basis.
Will you help us pass health department inspections?+
Yes. Our cleaning protocols are designed specifically to meet and exceed state health department standards for childcare facilities. We address the five most common inspection citations: changing station sanitization, chemical storage compliance, cleaning documentation, food surface sanitization, and toy cleaning frequency. Many of our daycare clients report improved inspection scores within the first inspection cycle after switching to GreenPoint.
Can parents see proof of cleaning?+
Yes. Our JaniTrack system generates photo-verified cleaning reports with timestamped documentation of every sanitization session. Facility directors can share these reports with parents through email, parent portals, or printed summaries — providing transparent proof of daily sanitization that builds trust and supports enrollment conversations.
How much does daycare cleaning cost?+
Daycare cleaning typically ranges from $0.10-$0.22 per square foot per cleaning visit due to the specialized products, higher sanitization frequency, and documentation requirements. A typical 5,000 sq ft daycare center cleaned daily runs approximately $2,500-$5,000 per month. Pricing reflects the premium products and intensive protocols required — this is not an area where cost-cutting produces acceptable results.
Do you clean during operating hours?+
Professional deep cleaning is performed after hours when children are not present. However, we can provide daytime support through day porter services for restroom monitoring, spill response, and cafeteria turnovers during operating hours. All daytime staff undergo the same background checks and child-safety training as our after-hours crews.
